rollback_rehearsal.action: Set dispatch_enabled false on Operations, retain the runtime-operations journal and execution history, and run recover before enabling dispatch. Recovery only observes. Retain preceding RuntimeRouter local compatibility path.
rollback_rehearsal.evidence: Case C snapshots and restores unresolved journal, recovers applied object, replays without creation, rejects stale attempt and accepts an absent command without dispatch.

remaining_limitations: The new journal service requires an OperationTransport implementing authoritative absence, atomic operation and execution deduplication, and backend generation fencing. No real remote backend exists at G1. The preceding local RuntimeRouter path is unchanged and the new service is exercised by mocked transport fixtures; worker adapter integration is supplied by later runtime packages.

The journal is Redis coordination state, retained by existing swarm snapshots; it is not a durable transcript archive. Dispatch_enabled is an explicit service construction option and must remain false while unresolved operations are reconciled during rollback.

The service stores payload digests rather than prompts. Recovery classifies unresolved operations by observation; an absent operation requires the original request payload for explicit dispatch. A stale generation raises conflict and preserves its journal entry.
